intro: F.M. Berkheimer has kept Central Pennsylvania homes and businesses comfortable since 1950, when founder Foster Berkheimer started the company on hard work and honesty. Now in its third generation of family ownership, the company blends those old-fashioned values with modern HVAC technology: real load calculations, NATE-certified technicians, and straightforward recommendations. The approach hasn't changed - no overselling, no cut corners, and no disappearing when the job is finished.

about: F.M. Berkheimer is a third-generation, family-owned heating and cooling company founded by Foster Berkheimer in 1950 and still serving Mechanicsburg, Camp Hill, New Cumberland, Carlisle, Enola, Harrisburg, Hershey, and the surrounding Central Pennsylvania communities. The company is bonded, licensed, and insured (PA006087), staffed by NATE-certified technicians, and partners with Mitsubishi Electric, Carrier, Generac, and AprilAire. Every call starts with a real diagnosis, not a guess, and the company holds to its founding principles: honest, reliable, professional heating and cooling service, with no overselling and no cut corners.

faq.q: What areas does F.M. Berkheimer serve?
faq.a: Mechanicsburg and surrounding Central Pennsylvania communities, including Camp Hill, New Cumberland, Carlisle, Enola, Etters, Boiling Springs, Dillsburg, Dover, Marysville, Wormleysburg, Harrisburg, Hershey, Shermans Dale, Middletown, Lemoyne, Lewisberry, Lower Allen, Shiremanstown, West Fairview, and York Springs, PA.

faq.q: Does F.M. Berkheimer offer emergency service?
faq.a: Yes. Regular hours are Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:30 PM, with 24/7 emergency service available.

faq.q: Is F.M. Berkheimer licensed and insured?
faq.a: Yes. The company is bonded, licensed, and insured (PA license #PA006087), with NATE-certified technicians on staff.

faq.q: Does F.M. Berkheimer offer free estimates?
faq.a: Yes. New installations come with a free in-home estimate and load calculation, and indoor air quality consultations are also free.
